programme.title: Tonari no Seki-kun: The Master of Killing Time
programme.desc: The original manga revolves around a girl named Yokoi who sits next to a boy only known as Seki-kun. During class, Seki-kun continues to not pay attention and instead creates amazing little distractions, such as a detailed golf course with the course's hole being a dent in his desk, or an entire dramatic war being played out by paper shogi pieces. Yokoi often finds herself getting reluctantly interested in his games, even though they always seem to end up getting HER in trouble with the teacher!

programme.desc: Canada's consumer watchdog series since 1972, this news program uncovers wrongdoings in the marketplace. With the help of hidden cameras, correspondents dish out the dirt on not so "clean" business practices. Once they get the evidence they need on tape, they apply pressure on businesses to change policies vis-a-vis the products and services they provide to the public.

programme.title: The Fifth Estate
programme.desc: The top-notch team of hosts Bob McKeown, Gillian Findlay, Mark Kelley and Habiba Nosheen provides unique and engaging documentaries from Canada and beyond. "The Fifth Estate" is a reference to the term Fourth Estate, and was chosen to highlight the program's determination to go beyond everyday news into original journalism. The series has won numerous awards for its reporting, including Gemini Awards, International Emmys, the Michener Award, and even an Academy Award for a 1981 episode that was released in theaters the following year. Since September 1975, Canadians have tuned in to experience interesting stories that are always well-crafted and thought-provoking.

programme.title: BizTalk | AI talent race and the future of work

programme.title: China's Industrial Chains: Threads of Resilience
programme.desc: What is clothing made from? Not just cotton or wool. Sometimes, it starts with a single drop of oil! Follow CGTN's Wang Tianyu and take a closer look at China's textile and garment industry, and unravel the threads that connect China's industrial past, present and future.

programme.title: Meet China: Flying into the Future, Growing a Greener City, and Connecting Business to the World
programme.desc: In this episode of Meet China, we explore how the future is taking shape across different corners of China and beyond. From Guangzhou's rising low-altitude economy powered by electric flying cars, to Xiamen's practical path toward zero-carbon urban life, we see how innovation is changing the way people live and cities grow. We also step into China's booming livestream shopping culture, where commerce becomes community, and travel to Malaysia's rice fields, where Chinese agricultural expertise is helping improve harvests and food security. This episode reveals how technology, industry and creativity are turning bold ideas into everyday reality.

programme.title: Proof over Promise: Insights on Real-World AI Adoption
programme.desc: At a moment when artificial intelligence is moving beyond hype into measurable impact, the key question is no longer what AI can do—but how it delivers at scale. From manufacturing floors to energy systems, the race is on to turn promise into proof. As home to one of the fastest-moving AI deployment environments, how is China translating policy into large-scale industrial application? Join BizTalk as we team up with the World Economic Forum, bringing together leaders from WEF, CATL, and Schneider Electric to explore how AI is being driven by real business needs, and how it’s redefining the future of intelligent manufacturing.

From Guangzhou's rising low-altitude economy powered by electric flying cars, to Xiamen's practical path toward zero-carbon urban life, we see how innovation is changing the way people live and cities grow. We also step into China's booming livestream shopping culture, where commerce becomes community, and travel to Malaysia's rice fields, where Chinese agricultural expertise is helping improve harvests and food security. This episode reveals how technology, industry and creativity are turning bold ideas into everyday reality.

programme.title: Proof over Promise: Insights on Real-World AI Adoption
programme.desc: At a moment when artificial intelligence is moving beyond hype into measurable impact, the key question is no longer what AI can do—but how it delivers at scale. From manufacturing floors to energy systems, the race is on to turn promise into proof. As home to one of the fastest-moving AI deployment environments, how is China translating policy into large-scale industrial application? Join BizTalk as we team up with the World Economic Forum, bringing together leaders from WEF, CATL, and Schneider Electric to explore how AI is being driven by real business needs, and how it’s redefining the future of intelligent manufacturing.

programme.title: Foodwise：Eating Global in Beijing
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May are in search of global cuisines that can be found in Beijing, the 3000-year old capital of China. From honest farm-to-table fare, to the culinary heights of French haute cuisine, and even a cooking class and wine and dine event at a traditional courtyard home in the city center, we'll discover that in Beijing, you can taste the world.

programme.title: Taohuawu New Year's Painting
programme.desc: Taohuawu New Year woodblock prints, originating from Suzhou, are iconic symbols of Chinese folk art. These vibrant prints, traditionally displayed during Chinese New Year, depict auspicious scenes, deities, and daily life, embodying wishes for prosperity and happiness. Explore the intricate carving and printing techniques that bring these colorful cultural treasures to life.

programme.title: Tasting the Lifestyle of Chongqing
programme.desc: This episode uncovers Chongqing's lifestyle, where hot pot is more than food but a city symbol intertwined with climate and history. Tracing its roots at a hot pot museum and experiencing mountain restaurants, we see its evolution from dockworkers' fare to a trendy lifestyle. Exploring graffiti streets, old teahouses and Hongyadong, we find Chongqing balances vibrancy and leisure amid modern development.

programme.title: Fun Guide to China: Hainan 2
programme.desc: In this episode host Tianran He continues his adventure across Hainan. This time, the road trip begins in Dongfang, where Tianran tucks into roast suckling pig by day and, by night, attends grassroots basketball games that rival NBA games in atmosphere. In the mountains of Wuzhishan, Tianran explores a lush jungle with forest rangers, before stepping back in time to 1988 for a retro-chic disco night. In Lingshui, the journey moves offshore as Tianran enjoys a seafood feast on a floating fishing platform, then heads back to shore to visit a contemporary art museum by the pier. After reaching Sanya in the south, he joins scuba divers on a mission to restore coral reefs, before winding down on a yacht with friends and laughter. Finally, Tianran travels to Baisha for the “La’aomen” harvest festival, where the local ethnic Li people sing, dance and celebrate their most important crop: “Mountain Orchid Rice”.

programme.title: Enchanting Xiamen Ep.2: New Jewels
programme.desc: In the second episode of our Xiamen series, host Tianran He and co-host Laura, an American who has lived in Xiamen for 7 years, guide you to discover Xiamen's internationalization, modernization, and unique fashion vibe. First, they cycle along the island road, taking in the stunning coastal scenery of the famous Round-the-Island Road, and step into Zengcuoan — once a small fishing village, now a thriving creative hub — to showcase its remarkable transformation. Next, Laura leads Tianran to experience the daily life of expats in Xiamen: exploring the lively coffee bar street, and joining a fun gathering at a stylish French restaurant. A passionate lover of Chinese culture, Laura invites Tianran to experience a traditional Chinese tea ceremony. After that, the pair head to Xiamen’s fashion central business district, experimenting with bold new looks in clothing stores that have caught the eye of the global fashion community. Finally, Tianran visits an egret habitat to meet photographers who document these beautiful birds, and together they admire the grace of Xiamen's iconic egrets.

programme.title: Enchanting Xiamen Ep.2: New Jewel

programme.title: Bird's-eye China Ep.5
programme.desc: Guarded by mountains in southeast China, Jiangxi channels rivers into Poyang Lake---the Yangtze's vital link. Starting from Mount Lu's misty slopes, watch and marvel as northern plains transition into an undulating land of hills and basins...

programme.title: Life as a Miao Embroidery Girl
programme.desc: In this episode, host Eva May travels to Maomaohe Village in Leishan County, Guizhou Province — a place renowned for its exquisite Miao embroidery. She spends a week immersing herself in the daily lives of local embroidery artisans, learning traditional Miao folk songs, and rising to the challenge of creating a piece of Miaoxiu embroidery with special cultural significance.

programme.title: Life as a Miao Silversmith
programme.desc: In this episode, Eva May steps into Maliao Village — a century-old silversmith village nestled in Leishan, Guizhou Province. Over the course of a week, she dives into the craft and daily lives of Miao men who carry on the silversmithing legacy. She works side by side with local silversmiths day in and day out, delving into the culture and techniques behind Miao silverware. She even joins master silversmiths for a live-stream event, before engaging in discussions with university professors about how traditional craftsmanship can fuel rural revitalization. On top of that, she witnesses the breathtaking sight of "maidens adorned in silver and flowers" at the grand Miao New Year celebrations, visits Xijiang Qianhu Miaozhai — the world’s largest Miao village — and learns to forge a small yet meaningful piece of Miao silver ornament.

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-1 Baji Quan
programme.desc: In the first episode of Season 2 of Kung Fu Wise, Baji Quan, host Kleber travels to Mengcun, Cangzhou, in Hebei Province. There, he meets Wu Hao, the young head of the Wu-style Baji Quan school. Together, they journey across the North China Plain, from bustling village markets and the family training hall to the Bohai Sea coast, as Kleber experiences Baji Quan’s explosive power first-hand. Along the way, the episode unpacks the idea of “opening the gate”, the key to focused power, and the spirit of spear work. It goes beyond technique to reveal Cangzhou’s rich martial heritage, tracing how Wu-style Baji Quan has travelled from its hometown to Europe, proof that traditional kung fu can endure, evolve, and thrive today. In the end, Wu Hao answers with action: true inheritance is not only about skills, but about shaping spirit and character.

programme.title: Foodwise: Wuzhen
programme.desc: Join our hosts Tianran He and Eva May as they explore the boisterous event of Wuzhen's International Theatre festival, with colorful features of both theatrical and culinary nature. Foodie Tianran and art-lover Eva are accompanied by ubiquitous local street food, daily carnival performances and meet and greets with fascinating personalities. Let's set the stage for the beautiful merge of food and drama as they taste their way through the charming scene of Wuzhen.

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-2 Chinese Wrestling
programme.desc: In Episode 2, Chinese Wrestling, host Kleber joins a public training session led by Wang Tongqing, a master preserving the imperial Shanpu Ying wrestling tradition. Swept up in the group’s lively atmosphere, he gets a first-hand feel for the master’s skill. Kleber then invites his Italian friend Paolo to train systematically, uncovering how Chinese wrestling principles connect with other martial arts, from Tai Chi to Wing Chun. Through Master Wang’s story of bringing a formerly imperial martial art into the public sphere, mentoring the next generation, and hoping to take it onto the international stage, the episode shows wrestling as more than a test of strength. It is a cultural bridge between history and the present.

programme.title: Foodwise: Quanzhou
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May are in Quanzhou, the ancient starting point of the Maritime Silk Road. From its covered arcades and Roman columns to its Southeast Asian vibe, our hosts discover that Quanzhou truly is a melting pot of world cultures. Then there’s the food: From the local noodle porridge that utilizes Silk Road spices, to fried vinegar pork and a dessert made from a special algae, there’s plenty of unique dishes to try here. Over a cup of oolong, our hosts will discover how Quanzhou’s tea changed the world, and how trade with Arab civilizations influenced a local fishing village. So join us in Quanzhou, a city that UNESCO designated as an “Emporium of the World”!

programme.title: Foodwise: Xi'an
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May venture to Xi'an, an ancient city with over 3000 years of history, capital to 13 Chinese dynasties. But first, our hosts are going to carb load on street food, from glutinous rice cakes and cakes made out of persimmons, to mutton soup with flatbread and the famous biangbiang noodles. They'll also taste the rich history of Xi'an by experiencing a Qin Dynasty-inspired banquet, and try millennia-old dishes such as trout grilled on a ceramic tile and calabash chicken, a Tang Dynasty delicacy. From the Terracotta Army to the Daming Palace, residence of the Tang emperors, to a dazzling nighttime boulevard that recreates the grandeur of the Tang Dynasty, there's so much to explore in Xi'an. programme.title: Discovering the Ancient Grottoes of Chongqing
programme.desc: The third episode of the Chongqing Series, Humanistic Chongqing, focuses on the Dazu Stone Carvings in Chongqing. This episode comprehensively showcases the profound historical and cultural heritage of Dazu and its vibrant contemporary folk customs, exploring the thematic connotations, artistic characteristics and historical origins of the Dazu Stone Carvings, as well as their far-reaching influence on the local people for generations.

programme.title: Enchanting Xiamen Ep.3
programme.desc: In the third episode of our Xiamen series, we introduce four expats from BRICS countries and their inspiring lives in Xiamen. programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-2 Chinese Wrestling
programme.desc: In Episode 2, Chinese Wrestling, host Kleber joins a public training session led by Wang Tongqing, a master preserving the imperial Shanpu Ying wrestling tradition. Swept up in the group’s lively atmosphere, he gets a first-hand feel for the master’s skill. Kleber then invites his Italian friend Paolo to train systematically, uncovering how Chinese wrestling principles connect with other martial arts, from Tai Chi to Wing Chun. Through Master Wang’s story of bringing a formerly imperial martial art into the public sphere, mentoring the next generation, and hoping to take it onto the international stage, the episode shows wrestling as more than a test of strength. It is a cultural bridge between history and the present.

programme.title: Foodwise: Quanzhou
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May are in Quanzhou, the ancient starting point of the Maritime Silk Road. From its covered arcades and Roman columns to its Southeast Asian vibe, our hosts discover that Quanzhou truly is a melting pot of world cultures. Then there’s the food: From the local noodle porridge that utilizes Silk Road spices, to fried vinegar pork and a dessert made from a special algae, there’s plenty of unique dishes to try here. programme.title: I've Been Killing Slimes For 300 Years And Maxed Out My Level
programme.desc: Aizawa Azusa, a corporate drone who died of exhaustion from overwork in her previous life, is reincarnated in another world, where she decides to live out a slow and uneventful life forever. But then, 300 years later, she discovers that the experience she earned by defeating slimes every day just to keep up her easy lifestyle has brought her to level 99 and made her the strongest in the world. The rumors begin to spread, and soon trouble comes knocking...

programme.title: I've Been Killing Slimes For 300 Years And Maxed Out My Level
programme.desc: After becoming the strongest in the world before she even knew it, Azusa entered into a new lifestyle with her first pupil, Laika the dragon, and discovered fun and enjoyment in it that she hadn't known before. But then, one day, a young girl calling Azusa her "mama" shows up and proclaims that her younger sister wants to kill Azusa. But Azusa has no memory of giving birth to these two girls, or of becoming a mother at all...

programme.title: I've Been Killing Slimes For 300 Years And Maxed Out My Level
programme.desc: Just as peace is beginning to reign in Azusa's home, a young elf named Halkara shows up pleading for her help. Halkara says that an energy drink she made angered a terrifying high demon, Beelzebub, who is now out to kill her. Azusa would prefer to avoid anything that might ruin her slow life, but she can't just leave the poor girl to die, so she reluctantly agrees to shelter her...

programme.title: The Great British Theft?
programme.desc: The Parthenon, the crown jewel of Athens, is a 2,500-year-old UNESCO World Heritage Site. Two centuries ago, Lord Elgin dismantled nearly half of its sculptures under false pretense and shipped them back to the British Museum. Today, the Acropolis Museum holds only a fraction of its originals. In this documentary, CGTN visits both sites to pose a candid question. Were his actions in the spirit of preservation, or was it just plunder?

programme.title: Wild Iberia
programme.desc: The unknown face of Spain. Snow, rain, clouds, and cold envelop the land. The ibex migrate to the valleys, and wolves patrol the mountains as vultures circle the skies overhead. Though the landscape looks bleak and barren at a glance, there is life thriving here.

programme.title: Giant Sea Serpent: Meet the Myth
programme.desc: Its 10-meter length and silver ribbon shape inspired the myth of the sea serpent. Off the French Riviera, buoys set 2,000 meters deep attract pelagic species, including the Giant Oarfish—“King of Herrings”—drifting vertically, alone or in pairs. With expert guidance and passionate collaborators, a scientific expedition unveils the biology of this mysterious ambassador of the abyss.

programme.title: Swimming with Legends
programme.desc: Shot over 2 years and in 9 different destinations, Swimming with Legends documents the life of a Belgium freediver Fred Buyle and his lasting fascination for the legends of the deep as described in ancient texts and mariner's nightmares.

programme.title: Wonders of the Arctic
programme.desc: Our ongoing quest to explore and come to terms with the Arctic is presented in the context of the crucial role that ice plays in the north. Ice is to the Arctic as trees are to the rainforest.

programme.title: Rocky Mountain Express
programme.desc: Rocky Mountain Express propels audiences on a steam train journey through the breathtaking vistas of the Canadian Rockies and relates the epic adventure of building the nation's first transcontinental railway.

programme.title: Killer Instincts
programme.desc: Battles for survival play out every day in the animal kingdom. For the majority of animals, each battle is an uncertainty. But for a fortunate few, the odds are tilted much more in their favor.

programme.title: Killer Instincts
programme.desc: They take their time because they know time is on their side. When the strike happens, it happens in a violent flurry. On this episode of Killer Instincts, we will meet three of the world’s best lurkers.

programme.title: Killer Instincts
programme.desc: They are purr-fect predators. They move with slow purpose. But attack in violent bursts. They are cats, big cats to be precise. On this episode of Killer Instincts, we will meet three of the most magnificent.

programme.title: Killer Instincts
programme.desc: Some animals simply take your breath away. Majestic in so many ways, they move with grace and attack with style. On this episode of Killer Instincts, we meet three majestic animals.

programme.title: Killer Instincts
programme.desc: The marine world is home to an eclectic mix of creatures each with their own unique survival skills, voracious hunting tactics and fascinating adaptations. We begin with the barracuda.

programme.title: Killer Instincts
programme.desc: Not all predators sit on top of the food chain. However, all predators need to eat. In the wild, survival often requires one to use the skills nature has provided to create opportunities for success.

programme.title: Into the Big Blue Heart: Ocean Currents
programme.desc: Jump in the flow of the East Australian Current with migrating humpback whales on a stunning journey that will reveal how the ocean and her currents regulate our climate, shape our lives and nurture incredible biodiversity.

programme.title: Anaconda - The Silent Killer
programme.desc: Few snakes are feared more and understood less than the anaconda. The film shows the journey into remote and uncharted parts of the Amazon rainforest to find the truth behind the mythical beast. Lush green forests abound with colorful toucans, noisy howler monkeys, strange tapirs, and vibrant Amazon Indian tribes. But hiding in the dense vegetation and murky swamps is also the biggest and most powerful snake in the world: the anaconda.

programme.title: Adventure Ocean Quest: The Giants of Rurutu
programme.desc: Humpback whales have come back from the brink of extinction, but they are still difficult to approach in the water and their behaviour and vocalisations pose many unsolved questions. Dr. Michael Poole wants to find out if the whales respond differently to a silent freediver compared to conventional divers, and has asked Frederic to dive with the whales and observe them.

programme.title: Mysterious Earth
programme.desc: There are areas around the world where planes, ships, and people seem to vanish without a trace. These zones have been blamed for mysterious phenomena for decades. Each place has an enigmatic and haunting story that has inspired geologists, engineers and archaeologists to study the science behind the myth.

programme.title: Mysterious Earth
programme.desc: It is undisputable that despite their supposedly primitive technology, the societies that flourished almost 2000 years before Christ were able to accomplish unbelievable feats that forever changed the understanding of the world for all humankind.

programme.title: Mysterious Earth
programme.desc: It was the Dark Ages… and from the cold North Sea a pagan maritime civilization exploded… and brutally raided and terrorized Europe… they were the Vikings.

programme.title: Mysterious Earth
programme.desc: China is one of the world’s oldest civilizations and has one of the most well-­‐documented historical accounts in existence. Rich with records of early dynasties, warfare, ancient traditions and architecture, China is home to some of the most amazing archaeological sites in the world.

programme.title: Animal Science
programme.desc: In this episode, we’ll examine some of the animal kingdom’s fastest sprinters, like the Cheetah. Also, the mysteries of animal intelligence are revealed as we take a look at Dolphins and Orangutans.

programme.title: Animal Science
programme.desc: In this episode, we examine some of the world’s most fearsome predators. Find out why Owls are the only birds that can fly without making any sound. And how the Leopard uses its amazing night vision to catch its prey.

programme.title: Animal Science
programme.desc: In this episode, we’ll feature animals that live in the freezing arctic. Learn how the Polar Bear has developed special adaptations that help it survive in the most unforgiving climate imaginable. And why the Wolverine is able to hunt so efficiently in the snow.

programme.title: Animal Science
programme.desc: In this episode, we examine the science behind man’s best friend – the dog. Find out what makes a greyhound so fast. See how a bloodhound’s nose really works, and the reason that border collies are so intelligent is revealed.

programme.title: Into the Big Blue Heart: Ocean Currents
programme.desc: Jump in the flow of the East Australian Current with migrating humpback whales on a stunning journey that will reveal how the ocean and her currents regulate our climate, shape our lives and nurture incredible biodiversity.

programme.title: Aging in the Wild
programme.desc: In this episode, we explore how different animal species react to impending death. We explore the factors that lead animals to their final resting places: disease, injury, predation, drought, famine. Some species, such as the naked mole rat, while not immortal, seem to be able to effectively protect themselves from certain diseases such as cancer. This raises questions about what is no doubt a sensitive subject, one that brings to mind our own mortality as we speculate about the reasons for this kind of resilience in our animal counterparts. What lessons can we learn from the animal kingdom? We follow individuals to their last breath ... not as voyeurs, but as spectators attuned to the circle of life.

programme.title: Aging in the Wild
programme.desc: In this episode of Aging in the Wild, we explore the physiological secrets and factors that determine life expectancy in various animal species. From the seventy-year-old elephant to the quasi-immortal hydra, and the more than a hundred-year-old tortoise, we explore life expectancy, longevity and senescence. Can we distinguish between the effects of the environment and the internal adaptations that lead to longevity? What are some of the benefits associated with aging in nature?

programme.title: Aging in the Wild
programme.desc: Reproduction is not only a concern of the young and restless: this episode of Aging in the Wild brings a light-hearted look at the issue of sexuality and camaraderie in older animals. We illustrate, for example, the link between the age of an elephant and its reproductive success. What are the reproductive benefits of these animals as they grow older? Through hearing their stories, we learn of some of the advantages - and disadvantages - of late-life reproduction.

programme.title: Africa: The Serengeti
programme.desc: Chronicles a spectacle that few humans have ever witnessed, the Great Migration, taking viewers on a journey with over 1.5 million animals as they travel more than 500 miles across the Serengeti plains in Tanzania and Kenya.

programme.title: Angkor: The Lost Empire of Cambodia
programme.desc: At the height of its power between the 9th and 15th centuries, Angkor was a resplendent city, considered the most extensive urban complex of the pre-industrial world. But by the late 16th century, the empire was in its death throes. The people of Angkor left not a single word explaining their kingdom's collapse. Come along this giant screen adventure to unveil the mysteries behind this lost jewel of Cambodia!

programme.title: Australia: Land Beyond Time
programme.desc: Stunning inside look at a land more like another planet than another country. Includes a rare natural event that happens only once every hundred years: the formation of a giant inland ocean out of nowhere in the middle of the harshest desert outback.

programme.title: To The Ends Of The Earth
programme.desc: The rise of extreme energy, the end of economic growth, the people caught in the middle. To the Ends of the Earth is a feature documentary about the state of our energy system today, and the people we meet are uniquely positioned to watch this global crossroads unfold. For example, the mayor of an Inuit village in Canada's high Arctic who is concerned that seismic testing for oil in the ocean is blowing up the eardrums of the animals that the Inuit hunt to survive. Or the environmental lawyer who goes on a journey to areas that produce energy for the Tarsands of Alberta – he learns of the inputs of energy that have to be put into this resource - and the reasons why the second largest oil project in the world is economically unsustainable. Or the river conservationist in Utah who fights to protect the Colorado River from oil shale projects that would disturb its headwaters.

programme.title: Mysterious Earth
programme.desc: Lost civilizations, shipwrecks, sea creatures and sunken treasure…our oceans cover seventy-one percent of the Earth’s surface and yet, more than ninety-five percent is yet to be explored. This final frontier offers a hidden world of secrets to uncover.

programme.title: Mysterious Earth
programme.desc: Alexander the Great…Cleopatra, Queen of Egypt…Vlad III Dracul, Prince of Romania…the legacy of these historical icons live on in our modern day culture, but the mysterious circumstances that surround their deaths and conflicting reports of their final resting places have inspired worldwide investigation and unleashed a furious hunt to uncover the truth.

programme.title: Mysterious Earth
programme.desc: Ancient architecture stands as a lasting testimony to human achievement, a visual reflection of the cultural needs and shifting beliefs of civilizations at different points in time. Archeologists avidly study the ancient architecture of the past – temples, buildings and monuments – to reveal clues about the ancient civilizations that created them and understand how past innovation has helped shape the construction of our modern-day world.

programme.title: Mysterious Earth
programme.desc: The unexplained appearance of geometric shapes in various locations around the face of the Earth has baffled archaeologists, scientists and researchers alike. These puzzling designs form mysterious figures and alignments that suggest an important purpose, but leave behind more questions than answers, a riddle of origin that buries scholars under mountains of speculative theory and drives their search for scientific proof.

programme.title: Mysterious Earth
programme.desc: The unexplained appearance of geometric shapes in various locations around the face of the Earth has baffled archaeologists, scientists and researchers alike. These puzzling designs form mysterious figures and alignments that suggest an important purpose, but leave behind more questions than answers, a riddle of origin that buries scholars under mountains of speculative theory and drives their search for scientific proof.

programme.title: Pharm to Table
programme.desc: How far would you go, to know what's in your food? As we go about our daily lives, few of us stop to wonder what our food is really made of. Taylor Lancastor travels 2800 miles on foot, to defend our right to know, and discover the truth of what we are being fed.

programme.title: Pharm to Table
programme.desc: How far would you go, to know what's in your food? As we go about our daily lives, few of us stop to wonder what our food is really made of. Taylor Lancastor travels 2800 miles on foot, to defend our right to know, and discover the truth of what we are being fed.

programme.title: Africa: The Serengeti
programme.desc: Chronicles a spectacle that few humans have ever witnessed, the Great Migration, taking viewers on a journey with over 1.5 million animals as they travel more than 500 miles across the Serengeti plains in Tanzania and Kenya.

programme.title: Anaconda - The Silent Killer
programme.desc: Few snakes are feared more and understood less than the anaconda. The film shows the journey into remote and uncharted parts of the Amazon rainforest to find the truth behind the mythical beast. Lush green forests abound with colorful toucans, noisy howler monkeys, strange tapirs, and vibrant Amazon Indian tribes. But hiding in the dense vegetation and murky swamps is also the biggest and most powerful snake in the world: the anaconda.

programme.title: Into the Big Blue Heart: Ocean Currents
programme.desc: Jump in the flow of the East Australian Current with migrating humpback whales on a stunning journey that will reveal how the ocean and her currents regulate our climate, shape our lives and nurture incredible biodiversity.

programme.title: Aging in the Wild
programme.desc: Observing two massive elk clashing their antlers is to witness a true demonstration of power. For other species, such as the European marmot, remaining in power is a matter of collaborating with family and community. Are these animals forced to give up their hard-won social status as they age? Through this lens, we take a deep and entertaining look at the challenges faced by those in power ... and what it takes to stay there.

programme.title: Aging in the Wild
programme.desc: In many human cultures, elders play a vital role in the well-being of communities and are responsible for passing down knowledge and culture. Is it any wonder to find that the orca, the elephant, and the wolf, have been found to transmit their respective cultures to the younger generations? Young animals learn by observing their elders. Judging when to fight or take flight, deciding how to choose a life partner, learning where to find food, these are just some of the skills passed down through the generations as elders share their wisdom.

programme.title: Aging in the Wild
programme.desc: In this episode, we explore how different animal species react to impending death. We explore the factors that lead animals to their final resting places: disease, injury, predation, drought, famine. Some species, such as the naked mole rat, while not immortal, seem to be able to effectively protect themselves from certain diseases such as cancer. This raises questions about what is no doubt a sensitive subject, one that brings to mind our own mortality as we speculate about the reasons for this kind of resilience in our animal counterparts. What lessons can we learn from the animal kingdom? We follow individuals to their last breath ... not as voyeurs, but as spectators attuned to the circle of life.

programme.title: Killer Instincts
programme.desc: It is easy to overlook the tiny in stature, but sometimes the smallest should be the most feared. On this episode of Killer Instinct, three big little assassins prove that size has nothing to do with survival.

programme.title: Killer Instincts
programme.desc: Apex predators sit comfortably atop the food chain. Cunning as they are large, they rule over their environments. Large and in-charge, their speed and bulk deliver a knockout blow.

programme.title: Killer Instincts
programme.desc: Venom, a lethal weapon brandished by hundreds of animals of all shapes and sizes, over land and sea. On this episode of Killer Instincts, we’ll meet three creatures whose venomous sting strikes fear in the hearts of people around the globe.

programme.title: Killer Instincts
programme.desc: Nature’s heavyweight battles test the most powerful animals’ killer instincts and their will to live. On this episode, we explore what happens when the world’s most deadly apex predators go head to head for survival!

programme.title: Killer Instincts
programme.desc: Nature’s heavyweight battles test the most powerful animals’ killer instincts and their will to live. On this episode, we explore what happens when the world’s most deadly apex predators go head to head for survival!

programme.title: Killer Instincts
programme.desc: Few things in nature conjure such instant fear as a set of killer teeth rising out of gaping jaws. On this episode of Killer Instincts, we’ll examine a number of sharp toothed animals worthy of a much closer look.

programme.title: Last Devils
programme.desc: Tasmanian Devils are the world's largest carnivorous marsupials and they are only found in Tasmania. Through hundreds of hours of filming in the wild, we reveal how fights over food are a carefully choreographed ritual, we witness the seemingly brutal mating process, see tiny young developing inside their mother's pouch, and visit wild devil pups play-fighting and hunting as they prepare for life in the outside world.

programme.title: African Nostalgia
programme.desc: Africa seen and described through the eyes of a wildlife photographer who has always been fascinated by the unique atmosphere of this extraordinary continent.

programme.title: Quolls: Fast and Furious
programme.desc: A marsupial native cat has stalked the mountain tops of its northern domain for thousands of years. In the lush tropical rainforests of northern Queensland, the largest surviving marsupial carnivore on mainland Australia has remained isolated and hidden from sight… until now!

programme.title: Ten Deadliest Snakes with Nigel Marven
programme.desc: Australia's renowned deadly serpents include the inland taipan, the most toxic serpent in the world, and the enormous king brown, which can deliver more venom in a single bite than any other snake. As Nigel counts down his top ten, he's helped by Steve Irwin's son Robert, whose favourite billabong is a prime spot for a snake on Nigel's list.

programme.title: Ten Deadliest Snakes with Nigel Marven
programme.desc: Every year over a million people are bitten by snakes, resulting in some 46,000 deaths - Nigel tracks down the ten deadliest. He meets an enormous king cobra and the infamous Russell's viper, a snake responsible for more deaths than any other. With the help of the Irula, a tribe of snake hunters, he faces off with kraits, vipers and cobras.

programme.title: Ten Deadliest Snakes with Nigel Marven
programme.desc: Europe is home to some 50 species of snakes; around 19 of them are venomous. Nigel crosses the continent in search of the most dangerous. On the Greek island of Milos there's an endangered viper that ambushes birds, while in Spain there are Montpellier snakes, asp vipers, colourful lizards and egg-laden toads. Amid ancient Turkish ruins he uncovers a massive Ottoman viper, a snake once used as a weapon of war.

programme.title: Ten Deadliest Snakes with Nigel Marven
programme.desc: Nigel comes face-to-face with the Philippine cobra, the most lethally venomous cobra on the planet. And in deep, dark caves on Palawan Island, the presenter searches for giant reticulated pythons sheltering from the heat of the day.

programme.title: Swimming with Legends
programme.desc: Shot over 2 years and in 9 different destinations, Swimming with Legends documents the life of a Belgium freediver Fred Buyle and his lasting fascination for the legends of the deep as described in ancient texts and mariner's nightmares.

programme.title: Turtle Odyssey
programme.desc: Sea turtles are some of Earth's most ancient and majestic creatures. For over 100 million years, they have traversed the seas, enduring mass extinctions and playing critical roles in maintaining food webs. But now they face a new threat – humans. It's time we learned more about these remarkable reptiles.

programme.title: Wonders of the Arctic
programme.desc: Our ongoing quest to explore and come to terms with the Arctic is presented in the context of the crucial role that ice plays in the north. Ice is to the Arctic as trees are to the rainforest.

programme.title: Sea Lions: Life by a Whisker
programme.desc: Between a jagged cliff face and a roaring ocean, lives a colony of Australian Sea Lions. In an environment equally as harsh as it is beautiful, be immersed in a classic coming of age tale guided by one of Australia's most unique, intelligent, and playful animals. Take an intimate journey inside the colony where a life of great intimacy, tenderness, and clumsiness, must often give way to a life of great sacrifice and bravery. Dive into the world of a rare Australian Sea Lion pup - and meet the people that are trying to save her species.

programme.title: Amazing Journeys
programme.desc: Experience the world's greatest animal migrations from zebras in East Africa, to millions of red crabs on Christmas Island, to gray whales in Mexico's beautiful lagoons, and monarch butterflies in the Mexican highlands. Travel back in time among exotic tribes of Africa to explore the roots of human migration.

programme.title: One Perfect Day in Kentucky
programme.desc: In "One Perfect Day in Kentucky," BFF’s Kimberly and Elsa bring their shared competitive streak to the Bluegrass State, facing off to find out who can plan the perfect Kentucky day. Each is determined to delight - and outdo - the other with unforgettable experiences that showcase the state's rich culture. Elsa kicks off the competition with a classic Kentucky breakfast, a recipe she learned from top Chef Ouita Michel at her Holly Hill Cooking Studio. Elsa wins the first point, but Kimberly’s ready to up the ante, whisking Elsa away for a thrilling cave kayaking adventure at the Gorge Underground. As they ride the chairlift to the top of the stunning Natural Bridge, the rivalry kicks into high gear and they go head-to-head in a trivia battle. The next surprise – a toast with Kentucky’s own Ale-8 soda , sourced by Kimberly straight from the factory only whets their whistles. At the Keeneland Racetrack they sip some spirit forward Keeneland Breezes while Elsa reveals all she has learned about racehorses from a visit to renowned trainer Mark Simms Jr. ‘s horse barn. A Betologist gives them a quick lesson on wagering and Kimberly’s horse wins the race. At Louisville’s Trouble Bar, Kimberly shares her newfound knowledge of Kentucky bourbon production from a tour and tasting at Castle + Key distillery and makes Elsa One Perfect Drink.

programme.title: Made in Britain S1
programme.desc: Op een nostalgische reis om twee van zijn jeugdfavorieten te herontdekken bezoekt Lord Prescott de Ribena-fabriek, waar hij ziet hoe de iconische zwartebessensiroop wordt gemaakt — met 90% van de zwartebessen uit het VK. In Herefordshire bezoekt hij vervolgens de Tyrrells-fabriek en ontdekt hij hoe een kleinschalig landbouwbedrijf zijn eigen aardappelen verwerkt tot ambachtelijke chips.

programme.title: Made in Britain S1
programme.desc: Lord Prescott bezoekt de chocoladefabriek van Whitaker om meer te weten te komen over de grootschalige productie van chocolade, van de productielijnen tot het proeven door experts en de rijke geschiedenis van het bedrijf. Daarna gaat hij naar HECK! Sausages in North Yorkshire, waar hij probeert zijn eigen recept te creëren: de Hull banger.

programme.title: Health Explored S2
programme.desc: Trek de Sahara in om te kamperen en de nomaden te bezoeken, om te leren hoe klimaatverandering het leven in de woestijn beïnvloedt en waarom tijd zo waardevol is.

programme.title: Quick Connections with Alie Ward S1
programme.desc: Wat is het geheim van het eeuwige leven? Alie Ward gaat van een eeuwenoud kruidenremedie naar embryonale stamcellen en het prikkelende vooruitzicht van een toekomst waarin we eeuwig jong kunnen zijn.

programme.title: For A Few Dollars More
programme.desc: The Man With No Name goes up against a lethal gunman as they both pursue a killer and his gang.

programme.title: Foxy Brown
programme.desc: Pam Grier portrays one of the screen's first action heroines with humor, sensitivity and steely determination. This electrifying revenge thriller explodes with all the sex appeal and cooler-than-cool attitude of its irresistible leading lady.

programme.title: Black Caesar
programme.desc: The brutal assault at the hands of a racist cop will inform the life of Tommy Gibbs (Fred Williamson, "Hammer"), who will grow up to become the reigning head of Harlems black mafia in "Black Caesar."

programme.title: Truck Turner
programme.desc: The great Isaac Hayes stars in this powerful, pull-out-the-stops crime thriller that pulsates with high-octane energy and nonstop suspense as Truck Turner tracks a sadistic pimp through the mean streets of Los Angeles. Nichelle Nichols also stars.

programme.title: Gang Related
programme.desc: Two killers are hiding where no one will ever find them...behind their badges! Tupac Shakur and James Belushi are two corrupt police detectives caught in a dangerous web of deceit in this gritty, smart and tough action thriller.

programme.title: Hoodlum
programme.desc: In New York of the 1920s, the black community of Harlem faces the same indignities as countless millions of refugees. Three rival gang leaders (Laurence Fishhburne, Tim Roth and Andy Garcia) battle for control of Harlem's urban power.

programme.title: Fled
programme.desc: Fled tracks two prison escapees (Laurence Fishburne, Stephen Baldwin) on the lam as they race against time to find a hidden cache of cash and an incriminating computer disk that could either bring down the Cuban Mafia or get the two killed.

programme.title: White Lightning
programme.desc: Burt Reynolds stars as a moonshiner who wages war against corrupt police officials in this action extravaganza full of epic car chases, bone-crunching brawls and terrific acting by a stellar cast that includes Ned Beatty, Diane Ladd and Bo Hopkins.

programme.title: Gator
programme.desc: The Feds want Gator McKlusky (Burt Reynolds) to go undercover to expose local crime boss and former boyhood pal, Bama McCall. When Gator discovers Bama is involved in extortion, prostitution, and murder, the suspense builds to an explosive climax!

programme.title: Running Scared
programme.desc: Billy Crystal and Gregory Hines have winning chemistry as two of the Windy City's finest (and wildest) cops, out to nail Chicago's toughest criminal in this comedy thriller that asks the question, "How come the bad guys always drive the good cars?"

programme.title: Tank Girl
programme.desc: In this laugh-a-minute, futuristic thriller, a mega-villain (Malcolm McDowell, "The Passage") controls the world's water supply, and it's up to Tank Girl (Lori Petty, "Cadillac Man") and her outrageous cohorts to end his greedy reign.

programme.title: Mad Max
programme.desc: In the ravaged near-future, a brutal motorcycle gang rules the road, terrorizing innocent civilians. But they underestimate one cop: Max (Mel Gibson). When the bikers brutalize Max's family, they send him into a mad frenzy and a need for revenge!

programme.title: Masters Of The Universe
programme.desc: The evil Skeletor (Frank Langella) is poised to conquer the universe. But fear not! He-Man (Dolph Lundgren) has declared war on Skeletor, and the battle between good and evil has come to Earth. Courtney Cox also stars in the epic, action-adventure.

programme.title: Hackers
programme.desc: Boot up for suspense and high-powered excitement with Jonny Lee Miller and Angelina Jolie when a group of hackers, the rebels of the information age, find themselves embroiled in a plot that could destroy the world's ecosystems…or their own lives.

programme.title: Hackers
programme.desc: Boot up for suspense and high-powered excitement with Jonny Lee Miller and Angelina Jolie when a group of hackers, the rebels of the information age, find themselves embroiled in a plot that could destroy the world's ecosystems…or their own lives.

programme.title: The Usual Suspects
programme.desc: This masterful film noir about five small-time crooks and a mysterious underworld crime boss enraptured audiences, earning a reputation as a "new classic."

programme.title: Ronin
programme.desc: Robert De Niro, Jean Reno and Stellan Skarsgard headline a stellar cast in director John Frankenheimer's action-packed and intelligent spy thriller about a group of for-hire mercenaries out to steal a top-secret briefcase for a mysterious client.

programme.title: Thief
programme.desc: Michael Mann ("Manhunter") directs this stylish, action-packed drama that stars James Caan ("Misery") as a master safe cracker who is planning his last heist for the sake of a woman, Tuesday Weld ("Who'll Stop The Rain?"), and a new life.

programme.title: To Live And Die In L.A.
programme.desc: Federal agent Richard Chance has a score to settle, and he's through playing by the rules. He vows to take down a murderous counterfeiter by any means necessary.

programme.title: The Mighty Quinn
programme.desc: When police officer Xavier Quinn (Denzel Washington) learns that his childhood friend has become the prime suspect in a murder case, he also discovers that he's the only one who feels that his friend was framed to protect the local tourism business.

programme.title: Cutter's Way
programme.desc: Suspected of murder, Richard Bone (Jeff Bridges) turns to his best friend, Alex Cutter (John Heard), for help finding the real killer. But when their suspect turns the tables on them, a cunning game of cat-and-mouse ignites into a full-blown war!

programme.title: Blown Away
programme.desc: When an explosion jolts Boston, bomb squad expert Jimmy Dove (Jeff Bridges) is thrust into the most harrowing work of his career. And when evidence points to his former mentor (Tommy Lee Jones), Dove must face a bitter enemy and a haunting past.

programme.title: Over The Top
programme.desc: A championship title, a huge cash award, and his son's love -- the greatest prize of all -- are at stake when Lincoln Hawk battles his strongest enemy for everything he has ever wanted. Sylvester Stallone stars in this powerful and exciting film!

programme.title: Cyborg
programme.desc: Jean-Claude Van Damme stars in this adrenaline-charged sci-fi thriller as Gibson Rickenbacker, the future's most fearsome warrior. In the wake of a plague, Rickenbacker must rescue the only person who can develop a vaccine and save civilization.

programme.title: Death Warrant
programme.desc: Superstar Jean-Claude Van Damme is Louis Burke, an undercover detective who is investigating a series of murders at a penitentiary. But when he unearths a shocking secret, he must attempt a daring escape that pits him against an enemy from his past!

programme.title: Double Impact
programme.desc: Jean-Claude Van Damme leaps into dual roles of Chad and Alex Wagner, twin brothers separated after their parents’ brutal murder. Twenty-five years later, fate reunites them and ignites their determination to exact revenge... with two times the pain.

programme.title: Maidan E Jung

programme.title: Astitva
programme.desc: The movie follows the story of Aditi, a devoted wife, who discovers her husband's infidelity. As she confronts her husband and delves deeper into the truth, she begins to question her own identity and place in society.

programme.title: Gulzar Dil (oru Naal Oru Kanavu Tamil) (dub)
programme.desc: It's is a romantic drama about Cheenu, a young man who initially pretends to fall in love with Maya as part of a challenge. However, he eventually falls for her for real, and they must overcome family obstacles to be together.

programme.title: Best Of B R Chopra
programme.desc: Dive into these timeless tracks that shaped Hindi cinema's musical heritage. The golden touch of B.R. Chopra - where every song became legendary.

programme.title: Hema Malini Parveen Babi Hit Bollywood Divas
programme.desc: The Original Bollywood Divas! Hema's elegance + Parveen's sass = Unbeatable 70s magic. Press play for nostalgia in every note!

programme.title: Dance Hits
programme.desc: Pure nostalgia on the dance floor! Celebrate the vibrant sounds of old-school Hindi dance music with timeless beats and retro charm.

programme.desc: In Japan and elsewhere across the world, conventional career choices are changing as people increasingly shift from white-collar work to hands-on jobs. We look at the reasons behind the trend.

programme.title: NHK NEWSLINE

programme.title: Backstage Japan

programme.title: NHK NEWSLINE
programme.desc: NHK NEWSLINE brings you up to date with the latest from Japan, Asia and around the world. Our team covers breaking news and major developments, with trusted anchors to tie it all together.

programme.title: Core Kyoto
programme.sub-title: The Art World's Genealogy: Respect for creative predecessors
programme.desc: A lineage of modern artists preserves and evolves Nihonga traditions, using the techniques as the foundation of their work. Convention and avant-garde, past and present resonate throughout their art.

programme.title: NEWSROOM TOKYO

programme.title: Trails to Oishii Tokyo 10min.

programme.title: Ukiyoe EDO-LIFE

programme.title: Hometown Stories
